title: Zden Level HALV
target_format: 256-bit private key as direct hex, P2PKH

derivation.summary: read the shape (circle or diamond) of each of 59 waveform lobes and any other channel needed, turn that reading into a 256-bit private key, derive P2PKH and compare to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: a standard public vector, private key 1 (the generator point); the puzzle's own waveform reading is not itself certified

difficulty_note: the waveform geometry is stably measured across 3 independent passes; the measured information capacity of the image (about 118 bits) falls short of the 256 bits a private key needs, and no hint has been published for this specific puzzle, unlike every other long-open puzzle in the same series

leads.title: a hint published by the author (none exists yet for this puzzle)
certify the oracle with a known-good vector
leads.cost: minutes, already done in this folder
